purpose: Add a lightweight YouTube embed placeholder that replaces heavy iframes (~800KB) with static thumbnail previews, loading the actual player only on user click.
riskRationale: The implementation is well-integrated into the existing buffer processing pipeline, uses proper escaping (esc_url, esc_attr, esc_html__), and has good noscript fallback for JS-disabled users. No SQL injection, XSS vectors, or auth bypasses introduced.

text: Well-structured feature that integrates cleanly into the existing lazy-load pipeline with good filters for extensibility and a solid noscript fallback. The YouTube placeholder pass runs before noscript tokenization and generic iframe lazy loading, avoiding prior double-processing issues. The main blocker is a duplicate global event listener that accumulates on repeated initVideoPlaceholders() calls; several minor attribute-preservation and convention-consistency concerns also remain.

reasoning: The duplicate error event listener is a real bug that must be fixed before merge — it degrades performance over page lifetime. The remaining issues are minor convention/UX concerns.

message: The YouTube placeholder replacement is correctly ordered BEFORE noscript tokenization and generic iframe lazy loading, preventing the prior issue of double-processing.
Three well-placed WordPress filters (wppo_video_placeholder_allowed, wppo_video_play_button_html, wppo_video_placeholder_html) provide excellent extensibility for third-party code.
The onerror image fallback from maxresdefault.jpg to hqdefault.jpg is a thoughtful defense against missing YouTube HD thumbnails.
The initVideoPlaceholders() function properly deduplicates initialization via el.dataset.wppoInit guard, preventing double-bound handlers on the same element.
Good noscript fallback — the original iframe is preserved inside <noscript> for users with JavaScript disabled.

initVideoPlaceholders() adds a global error event listener on every call. Since this function is invoked on DOMContentLoaded AND from the MutationObserver callback, each call adds a new anonymous listener. Duplicate listeners accumulate over the page lifetime, causing the thumbnail fallback handler to run N times per broken image (even though the second invocation is a no-op due to the data-fallback guard).
suggestion: Move the global error listener outside initVideoPlaceholders() and guard it with a module-level flag so it registers only once. The fix requires extracting the addEventListener call and wrapping it in a module-level boolean guard (videoPlaceholderErrorHandlerAdded), plus moving the listener assignment before the forEach loop. This is a ~15-line change and is straightforward for an automated agent.

message: The dynamically created iframe only preserves allow, allowFullscreen, loading, and title attributes. Original attributes like sandbox, referrerpolicy, id, width, and height are lost. This is a theoretical security downgrade for sites that configure sandbox on YouTube embeds.
suggestion: Store original attributes on the placeholder element and restore them on iframe creation, or add a default sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation".

message: New data attributes (data-video-src, data-video-type, data-fallback) don't follow the wppo- prefix convention used elsewhere (e.g., data-wppo-autoplay), creating a namespace collision risk with other plugins.
suggestion: Rename to data-wppo-video-src, data-wppo-video-type, and data-wppo-fallback for consistency.

message: el.dataset.wppoLoaded is set to '1' before the iframe is created or loaded. If the iframe fails to load (network error, YouTube blocked by firewall), the flag is never reset, preventing retry.
suggestion: Add an error event handler on the iframe that resets wppoLoaded and restores the thumbnail content to allow retry.

message: No loading indicator when the user clicks play. The thumbnail is removed immediately (innerHTML = '') but YouTube's iframe may take 1-3 seconds to load, leaving a blank container.
suggestion: Keep the thumbnail visible until the iframe has loaded, or add a CSS loading spinner shown between thumbnail removal and iframe load completion.

message: No test coverage exists for this feature. There is no ImageOptimization.test.js file and no tests for the initVideoPlaceholders() function in lazyload.js.
suggestion: Add unit tests covering: (1) initVideoPlaceholders click/keyboard activation, (2) the duplicate-init guard, (3) the error fallback mechanism, and (4) the PHP generate_video_placeholder return value for different YouTube URL formats.
